title: Activation Probes for Sandbagging Detection on MALT

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear theory: if prompted-sandbagging probes fail on natural sandbagging, this reveals a measurement gap motivating better data collection. Directly informs monitoring reliability assessments.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires extracting activations from Llama-3-8B, training linear probes, and evaluating AUROC. Single GPU feasible with medium compute. Beginners need familiarity with activation extraction, which is non-trivial but documented.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Scoped to one model, one dataset (MALT), one probe type. However, the limited number of natural sandbagging examples in MALT may make evaluation noisy, and activation extraction pipeline setup takes time. Tight but feasible in 30 hours with guidance.
